title: Rollback Combinatorics
tagline: Compare how different rollback log strategies balance overhead against recovery time under branching execution.

curves.label: Full Snapshot
curves.code: for (let t=0;t<n;t++){ takeFullSnapshot(); } // O(n) snapshot count, recovery proportional to depth
curves.name: Full Snapshot

curves.label: Undo Log
curves.code: for (let t=0;t<n;t++){ recordUndo(); } // recovery replays inverse ops, can degrade toward O(n^2)
curves.name: Undo Log

curves.label: Chunked Checkpoints
curves.code: let k=Math.max(1,Math.floor(Math.sqrt(n))); for(let t=0;t<n;t++){ if(t%k===0) checkpoint(); } // ~O(n log n) mix of checkpoint + replay
curves.name: Chunked Checkpoints

curves.label: Persistent Copy-on-Write
curves.code: for (let t=0;t<n;t++){ forkStateCOW(); } // structural sharing helps but pointer-churn can approach quadratic
curves.name: Persistent Copy-on-Write

curves.label: Delta DAG Merge
curves.code: for (let t=0;t<n;t++){ emitDeltaNode(); tryMergeDAG(); } // merges reduce recomputation but worst-case still steep
curves.name: Delta DAG Merge
